sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000117-P1, was presented by SEQIRUS (the Supplier) to Atlantic Health Network 117 on February 8, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 5.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,630 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
